result.topic_en: Calculations with the differential $\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-xx)(1-\mu xx)}}=d\varphi$, writing the variable as a quotient P/Q and deriving second-order differential equations for P, Q (and for logarithms p = log P, q = log Q).
result.transcription:
$\frac{QdP-PdQ}{\sqrt{(QQ-PP)(QQ-\mu\mu PP)}}$ \quad $dQP'-PQP'$[?] \quad $\frac{dx}{\sqrt{(1-xx)(1-\mu xx)}}=d\varphi$
$QQP'P'-2PQP'Q'+PPQ'Q' = Q^4-(1+\mu\mu)PPQQ+\mu\mu P^4$
$2(Q-P)QP'.P''$ $-2(Q-P)PQ'.Q''$ $\} = $ [-$-2QP'P'Q'$ $+2QPP'Q'$ $-2PP'Q'Q'$ $+2PP'Q'$-] \quad $4Q^3Q'$ $-2(1+\mu\mu)PPQQ'$ \quad $-2(1+\mu\mu)PQQP'$ $-4\mu\mu P^3P'$ \quad $y=\log x$, $dy=\frac{dx}{x}$ \quad $\frac{\partial x\partial y}{\partial\varphi^2}=\frac{(1-xx)(1-\mu xx)}{x}$
$QP'(Q-P)P'' = (2Q^3-PPQ)Q' - PQQP'$ \quad $\frac{ddy}{\partial\varphi^2}+\frac{1-xx\cdot1-\mu xx}{xx}$ \quad $\frac{ddy}{dy}+\frac{\partial x}{x}+\frac{xdy}{d\varphi}=\sqrt{(1-xx)(1-\mu xx)}$ \quad $+\frac{xdx}{(1-xx)}+\frac{\mu xdx}{(1-\mu xx)}=0$
$(Q-P)P'' = 2Q^2\frac{Q'}{P'}-\frac{PPQ'}{P'}-PQ$ \quad $+1-\mu xx$ $+\mu(1-xx)$ \quad $\left(\frac{P'}{P}-\frac{Q'}{Q}\right)=\sqrt{\left(\frac{QQ}{PP}-1\right)}.\sqrt{\left(1-\mu\mu\frac{PP}{QQ}\right)}=R$
$P''=\frac{P'P'}{P}+\frac{QQ}{P}$
$Q''=\frac{Q'Q'}{Q}+\frac{\mu\mu PP}{Q}$ \quad $\frac{\sqrt{pq}.\frac{dp}{p}-\frac{dq}{q}}{2\sqrt{(q-p)(q-\nu p)}}$ \quad $\frac{QQ}{PP}-\mu\mu\frac{PP}{QQ}=R\left\{-\frac{R}{1-\frac{PP}{QQ}}-\frac{R}{\frac{QQ}{PP}-\mu}\right.$
$PP''=P'P'+QQ$
$QQ''=Q'Q'+\mu\mu PP$ \quad $p''=q$, $q''=\mu\mu p$ \quad $4pq(qq-pq(1+\nu)+\nu pp)=qqp'p'-pp q'q'$[?] \quad $\frac{QQ'}{PP}-\frac{QQP'}{P^3}$
$\frac{\partial.PP'}{\partial\varphi}=QQ$ \quad $\frac{1}{p}=pp$[?] \quad $d\frac{\partial P}{Pd\varphi}\Big/d\varphi=\frac{QQ}{PP}$ \quad $1-\frac{PP}{QQ}$, $\frac{PPQ'}{Q^3}$, $\frac{QQ}{PP}-\mu\mu\frac{PP}{QQ}$ \quad $\log P=p$ \quad $p''=e^{qq-pp}$ \quad $q''=\mu\mu e^{pp-qq}$
$\frac{\partial\partial(PP)}{\partial\varphi^2}=QQ$ \quad $\frac{\partial\partial p}{\partial\varphi^2}=\mu\mu p$[?]
$xx\frac{\partial\partial y}{\partial\varphi^2}=1-$[-$xx$ ...-]$+\mu x^4$, $-\mu x^4$, $1-\mu x^4$[?]

methods.what: Substitution x = P/Q giving a homogeneous form of the differential
Squared first-order relation between P, Q and their derivatives
Logarithmic substitution y = log x and resulting differential equations
Splitting into second-order ODEs for numerator and denominator
Exponential form of the system for p = log P, q = log Q
